name: Princess Kaelis
bio: The excitable daughter of High Prince Malkanis, Princess Kaelis has become an inspiring commander in her own right. Arrows in hand and battle cry ringing in the air, she leads from the front atop Skyspur, her soulbound steed – and where she leads, every soldier in the Emerald Kingdom would follow.
